decisions.reason: Approving preset and custom tip choices does not change the fiat provider, conversion, supported payment methods, or wallet requirement.
The source approves the tipping interface but does not specify how tips are allocated or change the $15 mint proceeds.
Optional tips on the primary-mint page do not change secondary-sale royalties or their allocation.
The client approves the tipping design but does not request any corresponding FAQ copy change.
The tipping-option approval does not entail a change to the About page or its existing mint-price copy.
Tip amount controls are independent of Big Block prize amounts, funding, eligibility, and draw triggers.
The source does not require tips or tipping status to appear in NFT metadata and leaves existing metadata fields unchanged.
Optional mint tipping does not change which NFT state, book access, badges, referral code, or tickets transfer on resale.
Tip amount controls do not alter Small Block prize parameters, funding sources, or draw conditions.
The tipping design approval does not change SIWE authentication or the paths requiring wallet authentication.
The source does not connect tipping to badge awards or change the existing referral-based badge rules.
Approving optional tip amounts does not change the recipient or reward components used when a mint has no referral code.
